programmes.d: A top-level investment banker accuses her billionaire client of rape.
A man under investigation for rape and murder threatens to expose the secrets of those who are working on the case.
Benson and Barba ask witnesses to risk their jobs after a news anchor makes an on-air accusation of rape against her boss.
The investigation of a congressman falsely accused of soliciting underage girls leads the SVU to a sex trafficking ring; Benson and Rollins are the targets of a salacious website.
The SVU investigates when a woman claims a charismatic spiritual healer used hypnosis to incapacitate her and assault her.
After a young woman is raped by a member of her church group, Barba argues that the First Amendment doesn't entitle a person to break the law.

When a crucial witness in the case of a fatal hate crime against a Muslim family is deported, Barba must drop the charges against a suspect, resulting in rising tensions between communities on either side of the case.

The release of a suspect in a hate crime case leaves Benson and Barba caught between two families seeking justice; as public protests escalate to violence, Benson goes to desperate lengths to make an arrest.
Fin crosses international borders to catch a fugitive rapist; a political tug-of-war derails Barba's legal case; shocking allegations against Benson lead to the return of an old friend.
Rollins and Carisi suspect a woman's bizarre rape story is fabricated; Benson goes on the offensive when her personal life is scrutinized.
When a man is found castrated and left for dead, Rollins and Carisi uncover three female suspects who have possible motives; Langan gives devastating news to Benson.
A teenager disappears after schoolmates make her the subject of a vicious cyberbullying attack.
An old kidnapping case is reopened when a young woman is found wandering in Central Park; Carisi's conversation with a reporter puts him in hot water.
When a teenage girl is found dead, Rollins goes undercover at a high-end rehab center where the victim was last seen; Benson tries to overcome her doubts about Sheila.
Benson must disclose the secrets of her past to help a rape victim recall the details of one terrible, traumatic night.
The cops get tangled in an elaborate online hoax that leads to the rape of a popular social media star; Benson sets new ground rules with Sheila.
Emotions run high as the squad embarks on a frantic search for Benson's missing son.
The SVU investigates a case involving two students in a special needs school; Rollins discovers that one child's medical issues stem from a surprising source.
While investigating the murder of a billionaire playboy, Toby's curiosities about his family arise.
After being drugged, Toby is implicated in an armed kidnapping.
Toby goes undercover when he believes an innocent man is taking the fall for a murder.
After receiving intelligence on deadly threats to multiple locations that could lead to a catastrophic war, NCIS is called in to try to neutralize the danger.
NCIS works with the CIA to discover what secrets are being kept by Capt. Butler, an aging former spy.
Things become tense when Knight is assigned to protect his wife after the home of a high-level defense contractor is attacked.
Torres receives intel from a confidential informant regarding top secret naval information that's at risk of being sold.
